description: Search Realtor.com listings by city, ZIP, address, map radius or GeoJSON polygon, or pull full property/agent records. Filter by status, beds, baths, price, size, year, type, keywords, open houses and listing dates.

agentName.description: Agent or team name to search in agent mode, e.g. `Pedro Casanova`. Leave empty to search agents by the location above.
agentName.title: Agent name (agent mode)

bedsMin.description: Minimum bedrooms. Applied server-side, then verified on each record.
bedsMin.sectionDescription: Optional property filters. They apply in property mode when searching by location, address, ZIP or map radius.
bedsMin.title: Beds (min)

boundary.description: Search inside a GeoJSON Polygon instead of a named location. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude]; rings may be open and are closed automatically. Example: {"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[-95.6,29.6],[-95.0,29.6],[-95.0,30.1],[-95.6,30.1],[-95.6,29.6]]]}.
boundary.title: Polygon boundary (GeoJSON)

comingSoonOnly.description: Apply the source's coming-soon filter to for-sale modes. `COMING_SOON` mode enables it automatically.
comingSoonOnly.title: Only coming-soon listings

endPage.description: Maximum GraphQL result pages per search. Each page holds up to 200 properties; set 50 to reach the 10,000-row search cap. Agents use their own page size.
endPage.title: Maximum search pages

hasPhotos.description: Exclude listings that have no photos.
hasPhotos.title: Only listings with photos

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched by Realtor.com, e.g. `pool`, `waterfront`, `garage`, `new construction`.
keywords.title: Keywords

latitude.description: Latitude for a radius search. Combine with longitude and radius miles.
latitude.title: Latitude

listedSince.description: Only listings added on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for delta monitoring.
listedSince.title: Listed since

longitude.description: Longitude for a radius search. Combine with latitude and radius miles.
longitude.title: Longitude

lotSqftMax.description: Maximum lot size in square feet.
lotSqftMax.title: Lot sqft (max)

lotSqftMin.description: Minimum lot size in square feet.
lotSqftMin.title: Lot sqft (min)

maxItems.description: Maximum property or agent records to emit (1-10000). Property searches are limited by the source to 10,000 addressable rows per search.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Property status to search. `BUY` is active for-sale, `RENT` is for-rent, `SOLD` is recently sold, `PENDING`/`CONTINGENT` are under contract, `COMING_SOON` is not-yet-active inventory, `OFF_MARKET` is delisted and `READY_TO_BUILD` is new construction. Used in property mode; ignored in agent mode.
mode.title: Listing status

openHouseFrom.description: Only listings with an open house on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
openHouseFrom.sectionDescription: Optional open-house date window and map-radius search.
openHouseFrom.title: Open house from

openHouseTo.description: Only listings with an open house on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
openHouseTo.title: Open house to

priceMax.description: Maximum list price in US dollars.
priceMax.title: Price (max)

priceMin.description: Minimum list price in US dollars.
priceMin.title: Price (min)

propertyTypes.description: Limit results to one or more Realtor.com property types.
propertyTypes.title: Property types

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles around the latitude/longitude point.
radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)

recordType.description: Collect property listings or real-estate agent directory records.
recordType.title: What to collect

scrapeDetails.description: Fetch each property's full detail record: description, HOA, mortgage estimate, assigned schools, open houses, tours, photo tags, tax and price history, risk scores and extra agent contacts. In agent mode it also fetches each agent's profile phone numbers.
scrapeDetails.title: Scrape full details

search.description: City and state (`Houston, TX`), ZIP code (`77002`), neighborhood, county or a street address (`16142 Maladi Dr`). In agent mode this may be a city/state or ZIP.
search.title: Location or address

soldSince.description: In SOLD mode, only sales on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
soldSince.title: Sold since

sqftMax.description: Maximum living area in square feet.
sqftMax.title: Living area sqft (max)

sqftMin.description: Minimum living area in square feet.
sqftMin.title: Living area sqft (min)

startUrls.description: Realtor.com property detail URLs or search-result URLs. Detail URLs are resolved directly; search URLs reuse their location, mode and page.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Realtor.com Property & Agent Scraper
